name: Pawmot
description: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Tandemaus
description: use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

name: Maushold
description: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

name: Fidough
description: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

name: Dachsbun
description: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

name: Smoliv
description: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

name: Dolliv
description: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh- scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
description: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

name: Squawkabilly
description: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

name: Nacli
description: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli's body.

name: Naclstack
description: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

name: Garganacl
description: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: Charcadet
description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Armarouge
description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: Ceruledge
description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Tadbulb
description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Bellibolt
description: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly- button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

name: Wattrel
description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Kilowattrel
description: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

name: Maschiff
description: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Mabosstiff
description: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Shroodle
description: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

name: Grafaiai
description: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

name: Bramblin
description: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Brambleghast
description: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Toedscool
description: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Toedscruel
description: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

name: Klawf
description: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

name: Capsakid
description: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Scovillain
description: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

name: Rellor
description: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

name: Rabsca
description: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

name: Flittle
description: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

name: Espathra
description: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

name: Tinkatink
description: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

name: Tinkatuff
description: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

name: Tinkaton
description: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Wiglett
description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wugtrio
description: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

name: Bombirdier
description: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Finizen
description: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

name: Palafin
description: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

name: Varoom
description: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Revavroom
description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders- now numbering eight-to generate energy.

name: Cyclizar
description: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

name: Orthworm
description: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

name: Glimmet
description: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

name: Glimmora
description: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Greavard
description: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Houndstone
description: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

name: Flamigo
description: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

name: Cetoddle
description: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

name: Cetitan
description: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Veluza
description: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

name: Dondozo
description: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

name: Tatsugiri
description: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

name: Annihilape
description: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

name: Clodsire
description: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

name: Farigiraf
description: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

name: Dudunsparce
description: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

name: Kingambit
description: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

name: Great Tusk
description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

name: Scream Tail
description: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

name: Brute Bonnet
description: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

name: Flutter Mane
description: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Slither Wing
description: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

name: Sandy Shocks
description: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

name: Iron Treads
description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

name: Iron Bundle
description: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

name: Iron Hands
description: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

name: Iron Jugulis
description: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

name: Iron Moth
description: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with an object described in an old book.

name: Iron Thorns
description: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

name: Frigibax
description: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Arctibax
description: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

name: Baxcalibur
description: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

name: Gimmighoul
description: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it's actually a Pokémon.

name: Gholdengo
description: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

name: Wo Chien
description: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king's evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

name: Chien Pao
description: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

name: Ting Lu
description: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

name: Chi Yu
description: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

name: Roaring Moon
description: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to Mega Evolution that occurs in Hoenn.

name: Iron Valiant
description: It has some similarities to a mad scientist's invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

name: Koraidon
description: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

name: Miraidon
description: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an Violet Book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Walking Wake
description: Ecology under research.

name: Iron Leaves
description: Ecology under analysis.

name: Dipplin
description: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

name: Poltchageist
description: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

name: Sinistcha
description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

name: Okidogi
description: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

name: Munkidori
description: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

name: Fezandipiti
description: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

name: Ogerpon
description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: Archaludon
description: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It's so durable that being caught in a cave-in won't faze it.

name: Hydrapple
description: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

name: Gouging Fire
description: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

name: Raging Bolt
description: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

name: Iron Boulder
description: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Iron Crown
description: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

name: Terapagos
description: Upon sensing danger, it prepares itself for battle by creating a sturdy shell of crystallized Terastal energy.

name: Pecharunt
description: it's peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes  poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

name: Phantowl
description: They fly through the night in total silence, searching for prey. They can faintly see the energy of living creatures, so the darker it is the harder it is to hide.

name: Flairgrance
description: It unleashes waves of phermones to daze its targets. Its scents are powerful enough that some are used in making repels.

name: Arashinne
description: They are very clever and love to be taught new tricks. In the past, specially trained Arashinne were often used to send messages over great distances.

name: Dreadnaut
description: Despite its daunting appearance, it coexists peacefully with other Pokémon. It has never been witnessed feeding.

name: Boarlock
description: Its enemies can see visions of their demise reflected in its giant black pearl. Those that gaze at their reflection are lost in a trance and are easily compelled.

name: Heliomodo
description: Its paracolic frill allows it to harness and focus solar energy, which can be fired in the direction of its breath. It often scorches itself in the process.

name: Beefender
description: An unbelievably aggressive Pokémon, they evolve from male Combee in response to a serious threat against their Vespiquen.

name: Salazarus
description: It could evolve because it was unaffected by Salazzle's phermones. It attracts female Salandit, but it pines for the Salazzle that rejected it.

name: Gooschase
description: It keeps a watchful eye of its prey and only moves when unobserved by them. Only when it's too late will it be seen in motion.

name: Lepastry
description: It is desired by chefs all over due to its hammer producing the sweetest extract in the known world. The sweetness is so overwhelming it causes hysteria.

name: Brontonana
description: This long-lived Pokémon stores accumulated energy in its fruit. Unleashing all of its stored power at once will cause it to wilt and wither.

name: Dredwood
description: This pokemon is the soul of the forest and its greatest protector. It will bring ruin to all who attempt to destroy its home.

name: Corm
description: They release sweet syrup if fed a diet of sweet crops and fruits. Humans have domesticated Corm from its wild species thousands of years ago.

name: Iron Carapace
description: Studies show that this Pokémon's internal core is almost as hot as Magcargo. It is found around scrapyards eating cast off metals to power its body.

name: Kaiosea
description: It claims ocean currents as its domain and uses them to propel itself out of the water for true flight.

name: Marbeep
description: It is timid and stings lightly to avoid hurting itself. Most of those stung do not receive any venom.

name: Fluffbee
description: To repel parasites, they collect harsh pollen in their fleece. They often brush against each other to share their pollen.

name: Amphybuzz
description: They scent their honeycombs using the pollen of many flowers. They recognize each other at a distance by their aromas.

name: Phanfernal
description: Its pumpkin body can emit intense flames comparable to even a Heatran. The longer its flames burn, the more agile it becomes.

name: Skulberus
description: The alpha of its pack, Skulberus are rarely seen with trainers as they will only acknowledge the truly strong.

name: Velozel
description: They never stop moving, chasing the sun across the sky at supersonic speeds. You'll know one has passed by when your meal disappears with a sonic boom.

name: Burmy Eterna
description: It is covered with a cloak that shelters it from the cold. If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

name: Sagaracas
description: They thrive in the deep desert, gathering water from the morning mists. Their powerful arms rattle as they move, warning others to stay away.

name: Lucineon
description: It appears that this species evolves from Lumineon who reside in proximity to the waters in the Cave of Origin.

name: Scrafster
description: They keep their shed skin even after it has fully dried up to make them look more imposing. They use their tails as a bat to engage in combat.

name: Iron Voca
description: A peculiar robot Pokémon said to resemble Wigglytuff mixed with a pop star. It is capable of singing in any voice it desires.

name: Frostula
description: They construct breathtaking lairs of ice polished to a mirror sheen. Those who wander inside to admire the beauty are rarely seen again.

name: Cacjack

name: Tyranjoula
description: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Crag Hopper

name: Dedelibird

name: Charizard Mega X
description: A Charizard flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.

name: Charizard Mega Y

name: Blastoise Mega Y
description: The waterspouts that protrude from its shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of water can precisely nail tin cans from a distance of over 160 feet.

name: Beedrill Mega
description: A Beedrill is extremely territorial. For safety reasons, no one should ever approach its nest. If angered, they will attack in a swarm.

name: Pidgeot Mega
description: This Pokémon has gorgeous, glossy feathers. Many Trainers are so captivated by the beautiful feathers on its head that they choose Pidgeot as their Pokémon.

name: Alakazam Mega
description: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an Alakazam's muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.

name: Slowbro Mega
description: Its tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.

name: Gengar Mega Y
description: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

name: Kangaskhan Mega
description: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.

name: Pinsir Mega
description: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, Pinsir burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.

name: Gyarados Mega X
description: It is an extremely vicious and violent Pokémon. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.

name: Aerodactyl Mega
description: Aerodactyl is a Pokémon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.

name: Mewtwo Mega X
description: A Pokémon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans made its body, they failed to give it a warm heart.

name: Mewtwo Mega Y
description: A Pokémon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans made its body, they failed to give it a warm heart.

name: Ampharos Mega
description: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.

name: Steelix Mega
description: Steelix live even further underground than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth's core, reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

name: Scizor Mega
description: A Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

name: Heracross Mega
description: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.

name: Houndoom Mega
description: In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.

name: Tyranitar Mega
description: A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.

name: Sceptile Mega
description: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

name: Blaziken Mega
description: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

name: Swampert Mega
description: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

name: Gardevoir Mega
description: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its Trainer.

name: Sableye Mega
description: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

name: Mawile Mega
description: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

name: Aggron Mega
description: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

name: Medicham Mega
description: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.

name: Manectric Mega
description: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, Manectric were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

name: Sharpedo Mega
description: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

name: Camerupt Mega
description: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

name: Altaria Mega
description: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

name: Banette Mega
description: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.

name: Absol Mega
description: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that has a life-span of 100 years.

name: Glalie Mega
description: A Glalie has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.

name: Salamence Mega
description: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.

name: Metagross Mega
description: Metagross has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.

name: Latias Mega
description: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.

name: Latios Mega
description: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

name: Lopunny Mega
description: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

name: Garchomp Mega
description: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

name: Lucario Mega X
description: It understands human speech. It is said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect Auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Abomasnow Mega
description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

name: Gallade Mega
description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows when trying to protect someone. It can sense what its foe is thinking.

name: Audino Mega
description: Its auditory sense is astounding. Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

name: Diancie Mega
description: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world. It creates diamonds between its hands.

name: Rayquaza Mega
description: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.

name: Kyogre Primal
description: Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.

name: Groudon Primal
description: Groudon has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.

name: Rattata Alolan
description: A Rattata is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly moves its ears and listens for danger. It will make its nest anywhere.

name: Raticate Alolan
description: A Raticate's sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.

name: Raichu Alolan
description: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.

name: Sandshrew Alolan
description: When it curls up in a ball, it can make any attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has turned tough and solid as a result of living in the desert.

name: Sandslash Alolan
description: It curls up in a ball to protect itself from enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent heatstroke during the daytime when temperatures rise sharply.

name: Vulpix Alolan
description: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o'-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.

name: Ninetales Alolan
description: It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived Ninetales will have fur that shines like gold.

name: Diglett Alolan
description: Diglett are raised in most farms. The reason is simple--wherever they burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled for growing delicious crops.

name: Dugtrio Alolan
description: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.

name: Meowth Alolan
